top_band: none. The shaft at the middle column starts with a thin dark crossbar (rows 3-4) and goes straight into a dark pole (rows 5-31). There is no lighter top face.
evidence: The post is drawn as a flat front-view silhouette. The crossbar is a 2px dark line and the pole is a uniform dark shaft (L around 40) with no ellipse or plate cap, so it matches the guide's flat-band or rim-only column failure. The base at rows 32-38 has a lighter grey block (L 90-197), but it is a small plinth and gets no credit as a top. The lanterns are small details. No top face is visible on the main body.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 17 distinct colours against 38-40 for the references, and its dark edge pixels are 99% neutral, so the outline is a neutral near-black/grey line rather than a tinted material tone. The pole is a plain dark 2px line with no grain. The lanterns carry about 3 yellow tones and the base about 3-4 greys, so the shading is shallow next to the references' 5 or more steps. The piece is small and simple, but it looks thinner and more sticker-like than the stall and well.
